title.zh: 在八打雁省Bauan市镇正式设立San Teodoro村的法案
title.en: Act to Create the Barrio of San Teodoro in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas
title.orig: Act to Create the Barrio of San Teodoro in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Barrio San Teodoro tại Đô thị Bauan, Tỉnh Batangas
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ San Teodoro ในเทศบาล Bauan จังหวัด Batangas
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Barrio San Teodoro di Kotamadya Bauan, Provinsi Batangas
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Barrio San Teodoro di Perbandaran Bauan, Wilayah Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_943_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Pook ng Buhangin in the barrio of Ilat and the sitio of Cupang in the barrio of Gelerang Kawayan, both in the municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas, are constituted into a barrio in the said municipality to be known as the barrio of San Teodoro.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
